title: What moves after a lookup?
hook: Reading a key can reshape the tree around it.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary search-tree ordering; subtree size and interval notation.
doesNotKnow: Apply zig, zig-zig and zig-zag operations to move an accessed node to the root.

misconception: A successful tree lookup leaves its shape unchanged.
objective: Apply zig, zig-zig and zig-zag operations to move an accessed node to the root.

claims.text: The access path determines paired rotations. Bringing the accessed key to the root changes future access costs while preserving search order; zig-zig and zig-zag are different structural repairs.
